storylines: Coming into this match, all eyes are on Manager Under Pressure After South Town Defeat!
An injury disrupted rhythm and forced at least one reactive substitution.
Home advantage was present but kept within a realistic range.
Form and motivation were close enough that the match state, not just pre-match mood, decided the story.
